subject: Private deployment: evidence handover, witness session, and MSA addendum timing
messages:
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, contracts@helixhealth.com
Cc: Tom Hale <thomas.hale@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence / MSA addendum

Irene — thanks for the draft addendum. A couple of clarifying asks from Legal and our Infra team before we call the witness window: 

- Snapshot scope: we need confirmation the "sealed snapshot" will include machine images, database export (anonymized), and the trained model binary used in-prod, or an explicit list of what will be excluded. 
- Operator access: Helix would prefer a temporary console access for our third-party auditor for 7 days rather than a single co-observed session. The auditor needs to run a set of verification scripts; they don't need write, only read and query; will Redwood provide a scoped artifact?
- Evidence delivery: can Redwood provide notarized digest/hash and transfer proof (S3 presigned link + time-limited credentials) rather than a full file transfer?

We're attaching our draft evidence checklist for reference (evidence_matrix_helix.xlsx). Please advise whether the MSA redlines are acceptable or we should push an Exhibit F variant.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lee
Head of Security Operations, Helix Health

Attachment: evidence_matrix_helix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@helixhealth.com>, Tom Hale <thomas.hale@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence / MSA addendum

Sophie — appreciate the clear asks. Quick notes while we pull legal input: 

- Snapshot scope: Redwood can produce a sealed snapshot that contains VM images, production model artifact used for inference, and a sanitized data export matching your anonymization constraints. We will enumerate exact files in Exhibit F.
- Operator access: we understand third-party auditors often request a short console window; our security posture prefers co-observed verification + narrow read-only console rather than open 7-day access.
- Evidence transfer: we can deliver an encrypted S3 artifact with a notarized SHA256 digest and provide presigned, time-limited URLs; we will also provide a transfer audit log.

Attaching our current redlines to the MSA/order form and a short runbook preview so Legal and Infra can review scope before we converge on logistics. Can your auditor share the verification script set now so we can validate it won't require root-level access?

Irene Choi
Director, Deployments — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redlines_MSA_privdeploy_v2.docx, runbook_preview.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Helix asks re: snapshot and console access (recommendation)

Team — looping internal legal and infra. High-level recommendation for negotiation: 

1) Offer sealed snapshot + notarized hash + 1 co-observed verification window (up to 4 hours) for standard runs. 
2) For scripted auditor checks, offer a staged read-only console session (max 72 hours) that we host behind our jumpbox and monitor. All sessions require an NDA addendum + audit scope enumerated in Exhibit G.
3) If customer insists on 7-day third-party console access, require: (a) additional SOC2 attestation; (b) escrow-style indemnity clause; (c) a security deposit (commercial).

Attached a short recommendation memo. Please flag any legal must-haves we should put into the addendum.

Marcus
Senior Product Manager, Deployments
Attachment: recommendation_memo.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Helix asks re: snapshot and console access (recommendation)

Marcus — +1 on staging + monitoring. Specific legal language we should propose for Exhibit G: 

- "Sealed Snapshot and Transfer": Redwood will provide a compressed, encrypted snapshot and publish SHA256 digest signed by Redwood's KMS. Transfer via temporary presigned URL; customer will acknowledge receipt and run digest verification.
- "Witnessed Verification": Customer's auditor may conduct one co-observed verification session (up to 4 hours). If additional scripted checks are required, Redwood will provide a monitored, read-only console session (max 72 hours) with recorded session logs.
- "Escrow-lite/Contingency": For customers requiring continuous access >72 hours, include a temporary operator access addendum with defined indemnity and additional audit evidence (SOC2 or third-party attestation).

Also: require proof of auditor identity and a signed engagement letter specifying exactly which scripts may run. I'll draft Exhibit G wording and mark the key risk points.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@helixhealth.com>, Tom Hale <thomas.hale@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Private deployment: proposed compromise and next steps

Sophie / Tom — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Summary of what Redwood can commit to and next steps: 

1) Evidence delivery: Redwood will deliver an encrypted, compressed sealed snapshot containing VM images, the production model binary, and a curated data export meeting Helix's anonymization requirements. Delivery will be via presigned S3 URL; Redwood will publish a notarized SHA256 digest signed via our KMS.

2) Witnessing and auditor checks: we will provide (A) a 4-hour co-observed verification window (live screen-share + recorded logs) and (B) if your auditor needs to run additional scripted, read-only checks, we will provide a monitored read-only console session for up to 72 hours. All sessions will be recorded and audit logs provided.

3) Addendum language: Naomi will produce Exhibit G wording to codify the above; we propose adding a short escrow-lite clause that triggers operator-access addendum only if continuous access beyond 72 hours is requested. Additional continuous access requires SOC2 or equivalent attestation and a commercial carveout.

4) Timeline & logistics: 
   - Monday 26 May: Naomi shares Exhibit G draft.
   - Wed 28 May: Proposed 4-hour co-observed session (time TBD) — Helix to confirm preferred slot and provide auditor identity + script list by 23 May.
   - After successful verification: countersign addendum via DocuSign.

Please confirm the auditor's script set and whether you accept the 72-hour maximum for monitored read-only sessions. If Helix still requires a 7-day window, we'll need to escalate commercial and attestation requirements.

Next steps: Sophie — can you send the auditor identity and scripts by Friday (23 May)? We'll schedule Naomi's Exhibit G and route the addendum to Legal.

Best —
Irene Choi
Director, Deployments — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.ai
